prs.location: Blackwood Square achieves the perfect balance of green space and urban energy, with a mix of shops, restaurants, employment hubs and green parklands surrounding its Northwood, Santry location. River walks and sports facilities enhance quality of life, while transport links to Dublin City Centre are easy and frequent.

description:
JLL are delighted to present these wonderful apartments in Blackwood Square. The apartment benefits from - Spacious open plan kitchen/living room area - Private balconies - Expansive double bedrooms with built in wardrobes - Stylish ensuites and bathrooms finished to a high contemporary standard - A separate utility / store room offering flexible additional space. Washer/dryer included in utility. - A-rated energy efficient appliances. As a resident at Blackwood Square, you will enjoy exclusive amenities for the use of residents only. The residents will benefit from an on-site management suite with a dedicated scheme host. Furthermore, the residents will access to the Residents Lounge with free WiFi, business pods as well as on-site courtyard gym. Other onsite amenities include - 24-hour CCTV coverage - Secure intercom system - Bike storage and secure allocated parking - After hours management service - Landscaped gardens and courtyards - Play area - BER - A2 Rating. Blackwood Square is located in the amenity rich Northwood development in Santry. Gulliver's Retail Park is adjacent to Blackwood Square offering numerous retail and community amenities to its residents, such as Lidl Supermarket, The Range, Dunelm, Petmania, Eco Car Wash, Santry Sports Medicine, Hickey & Company, L.A Hair, Beauty Laine, McDonalds, Insomnia & Costa Cafes, McCabes Pharmacy & Eurospar. Omni Park Shopping Centre and IKEA are also just a short commute from the property. Blackwood Square is located right next to Santry Demesne Park providing over 100 acres of beautiful parkland with striking lakes and landscaped lawns. The location provides for great transport links to and from the City Centre and is only minutes from the M1, M50 and Dublin Airport. There is a bus stop located across the road providing the bus route E1. Blackwood Square's offering is truly unrivalled, providing modern living in a tranquil setting.
NOTE: The marketing material may not be of the exact unit available but are representative of the development rather than the exact specifications of the individual unit.
